subject: Re: Capacity lock request for SprintBridge — Dedicated sizing + contingency plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@sprintbridge.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 24 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing — next steps after demo

Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. SprintBridge’s latency and throughput targets during peak ingest look tight (50ms p95, sustained 9 rps/model across 4 models). You mentioned a potential production launch in mid-July and asked whether we can hold capacity while procurement completes.

Could you send the demand profile spreadsheet (expected daily tokens, concurrency windows by region, and any large-batch training/eval windows) so we can size a provisional capacity hold? If you can also list the primary models you plan to serve (or if you want us to recommend a variant), that will speed the sizing.

Goal: provide a provisional capacity recommendation + a 2-week soft-lock that preserves a slice of GPUs pending contract finalization. This will be conditioned on an agreed ramp schedule and a refundable reservation credit if the contract falls through.

Appreciate if Procurement can be looped in when you send the profile.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: (referenced, none attached in this message)

From: Alex Green <alex.green@sprintbridge.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@sprintbridge.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing — next steps after demo

Naomi — thanks for the summary. Attached is the demand profile you requested (sprintbridge_demand_profile_Q2-2028.xlsx). Key highlights:
- Peak concurrency: 9 rps across the 4 inference routes between 09:00–12:00 PST and 17:00–19:00 PST.
- Expected steady-state tokens/day: ~1.8B tokens.
- Burst windows for nightly batch reranking: 30–45 minutes at 50rps (scheduled 02:00–03:00 PST).
- Models: sbr-chat-v2 (general), sbr-rank-v1 (rerank), sbr-summarize (abstractive), sbr-fill (light conditional generation).

Procurement, please advise on timeline for PO & standard SLA. We’d like Redwood to put a provisional hold on capacity for two weeks starting June 26th.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Green
Head of Infrastructure, SprintBridge
alex.green@sprintbridge.ai
Attachment: sprintbridge_demand_profile_Q2-2028.xlsx

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 24 Jun 2028 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Dedicated capacity sizing — SprintBridge demand profile (action: availability check)

Team — forwarding SprintBridge’s demand profile (attached by Alex). They want a provisional hold for two weeks starting June 26 while procurement runs PO. Can you run an availability check and sizing recommendation? Specific asks:
1) Can we create a 2-week soft-lock (block GPUs from other sales commits but allow operational overrides) for the requested window?
2) Recommended instance counts and mapping to SKUs (e.g., 8xA100-80GB equiv) to meet 9 rps with <60ms p95 in our expected AZs.
3) Any constraints for nightly rerank burst (50rps) — does that require separate capacity or can we absorb into the same pool with autoscale headroom?

Please include quick cost delta and the suggested reservation credit amount if SprintBridge does not convert (we typically propose 10–20% of a month commit depending on horizon).

Tagging Aditya for availability + sizing and Ben for commercial/booking impact. Rishi, flag any concerns for model variants or quantization trade-offs that would materially change sizing.

—Naomi

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Dedicated capacity sizing — SprintBridge demand profile (availability snapshot attached)

Naomi — ran a quick availability + config pass. Summary and attached snapshot (redwood_gpu_availability_snapshot_20280624.pdf).

Short answer: we can offer a provisional 2-week soft-lock starting June 26, but with the following notes:
- Available capacity in us-west-2: 12 A100-80GB equiv nodes free for soft-lock; us-east-1 has 6. Total matches the baseline estimate but leaves limited headroom for unexpected spikes.
- For the 9 rps steady-state with p95 <60ms, recommended config: 8x A100-80GB equiv (primary pool) + 2x for autoscale headroom for burst. Nightly rerank (50rps for 30–45 minutes) can be absorbed with autoscale if we accept up to 120s scale-up ramp; otherwise we should reserve 2 additional nodes to guarantee instant capacity during the burst.
- Suggested reservation credit if deal falls through: $7,500 (two-week hold, refundable minus ops provisioning).
- Risk: if other late-stage deals convert in us-west-2 during that two-week window, we may need to either failover to us-east-1 (adds latency) or apply short-term proportional throttling.

Action items:
- Ben: confirm commercial terms for the $7.5k refundable hold + how that maps to billing/credits.
- Marissa: please clear finance pre-approval for issuing temporary hold (we need sign-off on potential lost revenue if we block resources).
- Rishi: any model-variant guidance to reduce node count (e.g., 4-bit quantization, distillation) before we lock?

—Aditya
Attachment: redwood_gpu_availability_snapshot_20280624.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@sprintbridge.ai>, Procurement <procurement@sprintbridge.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Jun 2028 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity lock request for SprintBridge — provisional hold confirmed (next steps)

Alex / Procurement — following internal checks, we can provision a 2-week provisional capacity lock starting Monday, June 26. Summary of terms:
- Reserved slice: 8x A100-80GB equiv (primary); +2 nodes autoscale buffer. If SprintBridge requires guaranteed instant burst for nightly rerank, add 2 nodes (optional).
- Hold period: 2028-06-26 to 2028-07-09 (14 days).
- Reservation credit: $7,500 refundable upon contract signature; if contract is not finalized by 2028-07-09, the hold is released and the credit is forfeited per standard terms.
- Acceptance: we need a short-signed provisional hold form or an email confirmation from Procurement authorizing the $7.5k refundable hold; once received, ops will mark the nodes as soft-locked.

Procurement — can you confirm acceptance and share any PO timing? Marissa (cc), please prepare the provisional hold invoice template and confirm how we record the refundable credit in billing. Ben, please confirm whether we need any additional commercial approvals for this amount.

Alex — if you prefer guaranteed burst capacity for nightly rerank, let us know and we’ll add the two nodes to the hold (cost delta ~+$1,200 for the two-week window). Otherwise we’ll rely on autoscale with a ~120s ramp.

Thanks team — I’ll kickoff the hold once we get Procurement’s email.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Attachment: (provisional hold terms in-body; invoice to follow)
